scripts.auth:copy: powershell -Command "Get-Content .auth/sf-admin.json -Raw | Set-Clipboard; Write-Host 'Copied .auth/sf-admin.json to clipboard! Paste it directly into GitHub Secret SF_STORAGE_STATE.'"
scripts.auth:copy-b64: powershell -Command "[Convert]::ToBase64String([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes('.auth/sf-admin.json')) | Set-Clipboard; Write-Host 'Copied Base64 session to clipboard! Paste it into GitHub Secret SF_STORAGE_STATE.'"
